heading: Upload tenancy or licence agreement
paragraphs: Upload a copy of the tenancy or licence agreement.
beforeUploadText: Give your file a name that explains what it is. For example, 'tenancy agreement - 15 Garden Drive'
uploadHint: You can upload a PDF, Word (DOCX) or Excel (XLSX) file. Each file must be smaller than 20MB.
